question: Where was the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association established in the year 1928?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was established in **Delhi** in 1928.
 
• It was an evolution of the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA), which was founded in 1924 to oppose British colonial rule through revolutionary activities.
 
• The HSRA aimed to achieve complete independence of India through socialist principles and was inspired by revolutionary movements worldwide.
 
• Key figures in its formation included **Bhagat Singh, Chandrashekhar Azad, Sukhdev Thapar, and Rajguru**.
 
• The association played a pivotal role in organizing revolutionary activities like the **1929 Central Legislative Assembly bombing**, aiming to protest against oppressive British laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Republican Association (HRA):**

 
 
• Founded in 1924 in Kanpur by **Sachindra Nath Sanyal, Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee, and Ram Prasad Bismil**.
 
• Its primary goal was to overthrow British rule and establish a federal republic in India.
 
• The famous **Kakori Train Robbery** (1925) was carried out by HRA members to fund their activities.
 
 
 
• **Objective of HSRA:**
 
 
• To establish a **socialist republic in India** by ending exploitation of the masses.
 
• The HSRA believed in direct action, including revolutionary violence, as a means to challenge British colonial authority.
 
 
 
• **Central Legislative Assembly Bombing (1929):**
 
 
• HSRA members Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw bombs in the assembly to protest the **Public Safety Bill** and the **Trade Disputes Act**.
